definition: A candidate the composer placed from further down its ranked list because fewer of the set asked for could be drawn than were asked for. A drawable one joins the set beside it; one still refused is named with its reason and not offered.
more: It is ranked by the same key as the rest, so a house that may be drawn but carries a fatal finding never leads one without. The composer places only a few more, within the set's time, and names any diagram it did not reach.
basis: Our wording of the composer's pool-fill. build/compose.py, compose: "fewer of the set are drawable than were asked for, the loop places down the pool"; build/compose.py, compose: "placed and still refused is named with its reason, and each the budget did not reach is named."
